name: Raindrop.io
description: Bookmarks, collections, tags, highlights, notes, files, sharing, and saved web knowledge through Raindrop.io.
agentUseSummary: Connect once through Relay-owned Raindrop.io OAuth, then let agents read bounded bookmarks or use the complete selected JSON REST API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

capabilities.label: Read bookmarks
capabilities.description: Read the connected user, collections, and bounded bookmarks.

capabilities.label: Full Raindrop.io API
capabilities.description: Create, update, organize, share, and delete through every OAuth-authorized JSON REST v1 endpoint.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Raindrop.io API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented JSON REST v1 operation; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Upload local files
blocked.description: Multipart local file and cover uploads require a separate user-selected artifact boundary; JSON API operations remain complete.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every other JSON API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected OAuth-authorized JSON operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, bounds, audits, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts selected tools and proxies OAuth server-side.
Railway mounts selected tools and proxies OAuth server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay must sign into Raindrop.io, create the production OAuth application, register the exact Railway callback, and configure its client credentials on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the Relay Console app, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/raindrop-io/callback, configure RAINDROP_CLIENT_ID and RAINDROP_CLIENT_SECRET, then run OAuth, health, a bounded read, and an approved or Dangerous-mode mutation.

evidence.supports: Raindrop.io documents registered OAuth applications, user consent, JSON token exchange, two-week access tokens, and refresh tokens.
The REST API supports GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE with 120 OAuth requests per minute per user.
The API reads, creates, updates, and deletes bookmarks and supports notes, tags, highlights, collections, suggestions, and permanent copies.
Commercial API use is permitted when the integration extends rather than replaces Raindrop.io and respects rate limits.
